blocks.name: Holo — lire LinkedIn
steps: In Google Chrome, open https://www.linkedin.com/company/loreal/about/ (the « À propos » tab of the L'Oréal company page). Read the page only: do not follow, message or click any button other than navigation. Copy every value EXACTLY as written on the page, character by character (accents, plural, spaces).

expect.secteur: sector / industry as written on the page
expect.taille: company size EXACTLY as written in the « Taille de l'entreprise » field of the « À propos » tab (e.g. « 10 001 employés et plus »), NOT the short summary at the top of the page
expect.description: first two sentences of the « Vue d'ensemble » text

blocks.name: Holo — note OneNote
steps: Open Microsoft OneNote, go to the section « Veille concurrence » and create a new page. The cursor starts in the page TITLE: type « Veille – {{Holo — lire LinkedIn.entreprise}} (n8n {{today}}) », then press Enter so the cursor is in the BODY. Type this text in the body: « {{Holo — lire LinkedIn.description}} ». Check that the title contains only the title, then stop. Do not modify any other page.
